admin.globalHint: Whole-game image indexes power scanning when no set is selected. Rebuilding pulls every card (both faces of double-faced cards), so newly released sets and card backs become scannable. This is heavy: tens of thousands of images, the CLIP model on CPU, ~1GB on disk, and can run for hours. The existing index keeps serving scans until a rebuild finishes.
